findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Code Injection
 * @description Executing arbitrary code via eval or exec.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/code-injection
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin(["eval", "exec"]).getACall()
select call, "Potential code injection via eval or exec."
findings.hypothesis: Code injection via eval or exec.

message.text: Potential code injection via eval or exec.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File
 * @description Logging sensitive information such as passwords or keys can lead to information disclosure.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/sensitive-logging
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-532
 */
import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::Node arg, Name n
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("logging").getMember(["debug", "info", "warning", "error", "critical", "log"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("logging").getMember("getLogger").getACall().getReturn().getMember(["debug", "info", "warning", "error", "critical", "log"]).getACall()
  ) and
  arg = call.getArg(_) and
  n = arg.asExpr() and
  n.getId().regexpMatch("(?i).*(password|secret|token|key|auth|credential).*") and
  not n.getId().regexpMatch("(?i).*(public|id|name|file|path|msg|message|format).*")
select call, "Potential logging of sensitive variable: " + n.getId()
findings.hypothesis: Logging of sensitive information (passwords, keys, tokens)

 * @description List regular expressions used in the code to check for ReDoS
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity recommendation
 * @id py/regex-usage
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-1333
 */
import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::Node arg
where
  call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["compile", "match", "search", "findall", "finditer", "split", "sub"]).getACall() and
  arg = call.getArg(0) and
  exists(arg.asExpr().(StrConst).getText())
select call, "Regex used: " + arg.asExpr().(StrConst).getText()

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Hardcoded Credentials
 * @description Hardcoding credentials in source code is a security risk.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/hardcoded-credentials
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-798
 */

import python

from AssignStmt assign, Name target, Str value
where
    assign.getTargets().getAnItem() = target and
    assign.getValue() = value and
    (
        target.getId().regexpMatch("(?i).*(secret|password|token|api_key|access_key).*")
    ) and
    // Filter out likely non-credentials
    not target.getId().regexpMatch("(?i).*(file|path|name|url|uri|format|type|config|env|example|test).*") and
    value.getS().length() > 8 and
    // Filter out template strings or placeholders
    not value.getS().regexpMatch(".*(%s|\\{|\\}).*")
select assign, "Possible hardcoded credential assigned to '" + target.getId() + "'."
